name: ShazzamLaunch
title: ShazzamLaunch - Global
summary: The ShazzamLaunch script include provides methods to handle the details of launching a Shazzam probe for a given discovery.
overview: Use this script include to launch a Shazzam probe during the discovery scanning phase.

members.name: ShazzamLaunch
members.summary: Creates an instance of the Shazzamlaunch class.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
status DiscoveryStatus The DiscoveryStatus instance for this discovery.
schedule DiscoverySchedule The DiscoverySchedule instance for this discovery.
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: addPortProbe
members.sig: addPortProbe(String midPPs, String portProbes, IPIncludeExcluldeCollection ipiec)
members.summary: Adds a single port probe to our MID services collection.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
midPPs String A hashmap with two properties.
  • midServer: a MIDServer instance
  • portProbes: a hashmap (by port probe name) of DiscoveryPortProbe instances.
portProbes String A hashmap (byMIDServer name) that contains these properties.
  • range: An IPMetaCollection containing the ranges to be probed.
  • midserver: A MIDServer instance for the MID server to be probed.
  • portProbes: a hashmap (by port probe name) of DiscoveryPortProbe instances to be probed.
ipiec IPIncludeExcludeCollection The range to be probed.
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: addRange
members.sig: addRange(IPCollection ipc, String portProbes, Boolean samePhase)
members.summary: Adds the specified range and this discovery's port probes to scan (as defined by behavior) to the collection of MID servers and port probes that need to be probed.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
ipc IPCollection The range to be discovered
portProbes String A hashmap (by MID server name) of hashmaps containing these properties.
  • range: an IPMetaCollection containing the ranges to be probed.
  • midServer: a Mid server instance for the MID server to be probed.
  • portProbes: a hashmap (by port probe name) of DiscoveryPortProbe instances to be probed.
samePhase Boolean True if this should use the same phase as is currently running.
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: fireShazzamProbe
members.sig: fireShazzamProbe(String portProbe, String ip, String sensor)
members.summary: Fires a Shazzam probe for the MID server and services in the given hash map.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
portProbe String A hashmap containing these properties.
  • range: an IPMetaCollection containing the ranges to be probed.
  • midServer: a MIDServer instance for the MID server to be probed.
ip String A comma-separated list of IPs to fire probes for.
sensor String The sys_id of the sensor that launched this probe (network discovery only).
Returns
Type Description
void

members.name: launch
members.sig: launch(String ip, Boolean samePhase, String sensor)
members.summary: Launches Shazzam probes as necessary, depending on the current phase of each behavior used.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
ip String A comma-separated list of IPs to fire probes for.
samePhase Boolean True if this launch should use the same phase as is currently running.
sensor String The sys_id of the sensor that launched this (only in network discovery).
Returns
Type Description
Boolean True if any probes are launched.
